subject: general
question: The novel ‘Raavan - Enemy of Aryavarta’ is written by whom among the following writers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amish Tripathi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Amish Tripathi is an Indian author.
 
• He is known for his book series Shiva Trilogy and Ram Chandra Series.
 
• Raavan: Enemy of Aryavarta is the seventh book of Amish Tripathi, sixth book of Amishverse, and third book of Ram Chandra Series.
 
• It chronicles the life of Ravan until the time he kidnaps Sita.
 
• The book was released on 1 July 2019 and published by Westland.
